  •  Greatly increases reload speed

Rounds ricochet off hard surfaces.

perks.name: Light Mag
perks.desc:
Improved reload and range.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Armor-Piercing Rounds
perks.desc:
Rounds cause extra damage to combatants' shields and overpenetrate targets. 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Drop Mag
perks.desc: Increases reload speed but reduces magazine size.

perks.name: Assault Mag
perks.desc:
This shotgun's magazine is optimized for quick combat.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases rate of fire

perks.name: High-Caliber Rounds
perks.desc:
Shots from this weapon knock the target back farther.
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Barrel Constrictor
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon reduce its projectile spread for a short duration.

perks.name: Threat Remover
perks.desc: Dealing damage with all pellets in a spread increases reload speed, handling, and stability.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.desc: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

perks.name: Transcendent Moment
perks.desc: Final blows grant bonus stats based on the weapon's damage type alignment. Light elements grant stability and handling. Dark elements grant range and aim assist. While Transcendent, this weapon gets both bonuses.

perks.name: Proximity Power
perks.desc: When targets are nearby, final blows grant bonus Melee stat.

perks.name: One-Two Punch
perks.desc: Hitting an enemy with every pellet in a shot increases melee damage for a short duration.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.desc: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Tenacity
perks.desc: When targets are nearby, final blows grant weapon damage, reload speed, and handling until the wielder's death.

perks.name: Häkke Breach Armaments
perks.desc:
This weapon deals increased damage against vehicles and constructs.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 148 from 5 August 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/3S0TObWihybmZdCLM6wIUw?si=cf08fccbb9d44fa7) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for melee builds and clearing Minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. Phoneutria Fera is one of a new hand cannon subfamily - Spread Shot, combining elements of hand cannons and shotguns. At base, there's not really much of a comparison to be made as the only other example has a completely different stat package - this looks like HC values, whereas Aureus Neutralizer looks more like a shotgun. That said, d2foundry.gg hasn't worked out the formula to calculate real-world values from stats at time of writing, but the Range is 35 - this does seem to be fixed at around 25m, after which pellets just vanish, Stability is 40, Handling is 35, Reload Speed is 25. Ammo Generation is 56, Recoil Direction is 93, and Zoom is 14. Bumping up Handling with the barrel perk will make the gunfeel noticibly snappier, but on controller you might want to look at Stability too. For the magazine perk, Tactical Mag, Flared Magwell and Alloy Mag are all reliable options for boosting gunfeel stats. With an engagement range of 25m max, CQC perks are going to be useful in the trait perk columns. Threat Remover is strong - hitting 11 of 12 pellets (10 out of 12 when enhanced) improves Handling, Stability and Reload Speed for 7s, as is Threat Detector which boosts Stability by up to +40, Reload Speed by up to +60 (+44 and +63 when enhanced), and Handling by up to +100 with an ×0.81 animation modifier when within 15m of two or more enemies. For melee builds, Proximity Power can stack three times to provide +15 (+18 when enhanced) to your Melee stat per stack - a total a +45 (+54) for 10s, refreshable on further kills. In the second column, One-Two Punch boosts melee damage by +75% for 3s (melee damage buffs are additive rather than multiplicative) on hitting all 12 pellets (10 when enhanced) - that's less than a shotgun, but the unlimited ammo for primary weapons makes the tradeoff worthwhile. The Tenacity Origin Trait is solid in PvE, stack up to ×30 on kills, with each stack providing a ×1.005 boost (so up to ×1.15 - the same as Frenzy) and +2 to both Handling and Reload, until you're killed. If you're interested, Phoneutria fera is a mix of Greek and Latin that translates as "Murderess, wild animal" and is a species of South American spider, commonly known as the Brazilian Wandering Spider or Banana Spider. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
